factory_reset.description: The reset is the battery, and that is the whole procedure: Ruuvi documents no button-based reset and no hold time. A related detail from the same page saves a lot of confusion — the sensors appear in a phone's Bluetooth settings but cannot be connected from there, which is exactly what an advertisement-first device that never bonds looks like, and not a fault to be reset away.
factory_reset.effect: Restarts the sensor and, on stock firmware, clears the measurement history held on the tag. There are no credentials, no bond and no network membership to clear — a RuuviTag broadcasts and nothing else.

procedures.basis: Ruuvi's own support documentation on powering and resetting RuuviTag.
procedures.name: Remove and reinsert the coin cell

steps.action: Open the enclosure and take out the coin cell.
Reinsert it. The sensor restarts on its own.
steps.expect: The tag resumes advertising; stored history is gone.

data_format_3.description: RAWv1 (DF3), 14-byte manufacturer-data payload. Multi-byte integers are big-endian except the sign-magnitude temperature pair.

fields.description: Sign-magnitude @2-3: (-1 if byte2 & 0x80 else +1) * ((byte2 & 0x7F) + byte3/100). Not int16.
fields.name: temperature

fields.description: u16 BE @4 + 50000 Pa. Raw 0xFFFF is a valid pressure here; do not import DF5's pressure sentinel.
fields.name: pressure

parse_rules: The official example decodes to 26.30 C, 20.5 %RH, 102766 Pa, acceleration (-1000, -1726, +714) mG and 2899 mV.
Temperature bytes 81 45 decode as -(1 + 0x45/100) = -1.69 C; do not two's-complement the pair.

data_format_5.description: RAWv2 (DF5), 24-byte manufacturer-data payload; multi-byte fields MSB-first.

fields.description: Three s16 BE values at @7/@9/@11, 1 mG; 0x8000 invalid per axis.
fields.name: acceleration_xyz

fields.description: u16 BE @13. Battery raw = value >> 5, unavailable at 0x7FF, otherwise battery_mV = raw + 1600. TX raw = value & 0x1F, unavailable at 0x1F, otherwise TX_dBm = -40 + 2*raw. Test each sentinel independently before scaling.
fields.name: power_info

fields.description: Six-byte MAC @18; FF FF FF FF FF FF means unavailable.
fields.name: mac

parse_rules: A leading byte 0x03 is the legacy 14-byte DF3 layout instead; decode accordingly.
Treat per-field sentinels as unavailable before sign extension or scaling: 0x8000 / 0xFFFF / 0xFF, battery raw 0x7FF, TX raw 0x1F, and all-ones MAC.
The power fixture uses raw 0xAC36: battery = (0xAC36 >> 5) + 1600 = 2977 mV and TX = -40 + 2*(0xAC36 & 0x1F) = +4 dBm.
